routes.name: Schengen short stay (visa-free or Schengen visa)
routes.summary: Iceland is in Schengen. Visa-free nationals can stay up to 90 days in any 180. Others need a Schengen visa. I could not confirm the official list or fees.

other: Official visa-free and visa-required lists were not read. Check island.is and the Schengen visa pages.

routes.name: Long-term visa for remote workers
routes.summary: Iceland has a long-term visa for remote workers and their family members. The official page was unreachable, so income, length and fees are not confirmed.

other: Income, duration and fee not confirmed. Official page: utl.is long-term visa for remote workers and their family members.

routes.name: Residence permit based on work
routes.summary: A work residence permit needs a job with a specific employer. Types: special skills, labor shortage, athletes, and specialized staff under service contracts.

income.note: Pre-tax. Cash does not count. Amount applies from 18 May 2026.

eligibility.education: For special skills: university degree or recognized industrial, artistic or technical training
other: Health insurance valid in Iceland for at least 3 months, minimum cover 2,000,000 ISK
No criminal record that bars entry

steps: Get a work permit for a specific job and employer
Gather passport, proof of means of support, health insurance
Fill in the application form D-107
Book a residence card photo appointment

routes.name: Residence permit for students
routes.summary: For full-time students at an Icelandic school. Granted up to one year at a time and renewable with satisfactory results.

other: Enrolled full-time at an Icelandic school
Means of support not stated on the page, check the application form

stay.note: Permit can be revoked if you stay abroad more than 3 months in a row.

routes.name: Working Holiday / Youth Mobility permit
routes.summary: For ages 18 to 30 from Andorra, Canada, Chile, Japan and the UK. Meant for experiencing Icelandic culture.

income.note: For 3 months after the permit is issued

other: No earlier Iceland Working Holiday permit
Health insurance for at least 3 months, minimum cover 2,000,000 ISK
Permit length not stated on the page

routes.name: Residence permit for children (family reunification)
routes.summary: For a child under 18 in the custody of a parent who lives in Iceland as a citizen, permanent resident, or on certain temporary permits.

other: Child under 18 when applying
Child lives with and is supported by the parent in Iceland
Other custodial parent must agree
Parent has no recent listed convictions

routes.name: Residence permit based on special ties
routes.summary: Only granted in exceptional cases. Family ties alone do not count and fall under family reunification rules. Spouses and partners and parents of Icelanders: check the official family reunification pages, which I could not read.

income.note: Pre-tax. Cash does not count. Amount applies from 18 May 2026.

other: Plus 129,976 ISK per month for each family member 18 or older
Married spouses can show means for both
Ties built on student, volunteer, au pair or working holiday stays do not count
Spouse and partner permits were not confirmed

routes.name: Permanent residence permit
routes.summary: Usually 4 continuous years on a qualifying permit plus Icelandic language proof. Shorter for spouses of citizens (3 years) and children of citizens (2 years).

eligibility.language: 150 Icelandic lessons with 85% attendance, or a recognized Icelandic test

income.note: Pre-tax. Cash does not count. Amount applies from 18 May 2026.

other: No more than 90 days abroad per year
No open criminal or expulsion case
Couples need 415,922 ISK per month

routes.name: Icelandic citizenship by naturalization
routes.summary: General rule is 7 years of residence. Nordic citizens 4, refugees 5, married to a citizen 4, cohabiting 5. Needs permanent residence and the Icelandic citizenship test.

income.note: Pre-tax. Cash does not count. Amount applies from 18 May 2026.

other: Permanent residence permit unless Nordic or EEA/EFTA
No debts, no municipal aid for 3 years
Clean criminal record rules apply
Max 90 days abroad per 12 months
